<script>
    globalThis.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const componentIdLoadWaitTime = 5000;
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');

            const originalHash = location.hash;

            const startTimeRepeat = Date.now();
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);
                const timeWaitExceeded = Date.now() - startTimeRepeat > componentIdLoadWaitTime;

                const hashStillRelevant = location.hash === originalHash;

                if (elementToScroll && hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: 'smooth',
                            block: 'start'
                        });
                    }, 50);
                }

                if (timeWaitExceeded || !hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                }
            }, 50);
        }
    });

    globalThis.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');
            setTimeout(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);

                if (elementToScroll) {
                    elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    globalThis.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const componentIdLoadWaitTime = 5000;
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');

            const originalHash = location.hash;

            const startTimeRepeat = Date.now();
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);
                const timeWaitExceeded = Date.now() - startTimeRepeat > componentIdLoadWaitTime;

                const hashStillRelevant = location.hash === originalHash;

                if (elementToScroll && hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: 'smooth',
                            block: 'start'
                        });
                    }, 50);
                }

                if (timeWaitExceeded || !hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                }
            }, 50);
        }
    });

    globalThis.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');
            setTimeout(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);

                if (elementToScroll) {
                    elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    globalThis.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const componentIdLoadWaitTime = 5000;
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');

            const originalHash = location.hash;

            const startTimeRepeat = Date.now();
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);
                const timeWaitExceeded = Date.now() - startTimeRepeat > componentIdLoadWaitTime;

                const hashStillRelevant = location.hash === originalHash;

                if (elementToScroll && hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: 'smooth',
                            block: 'start'
                        });
                    }, 50);
                }

                if (timeWaitExceeded || !hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                }
            }, 50);
        }
    });

    globalThis.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');
            setTimeout(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);

                if (elementToScroll) {
                    elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        }
    });
</script>

    globalThis.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const componentIdLoadWaitTime = 5000;
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');

            const originalHash = location.hash;

            const startTimeRepeat = Date.now();
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);
                const timeWaitExceeded = Date.now() - startTimeRepeat > componentIdLoadWaitTime;

                const hashStillRelevant = location.hash === originalHash;

                if (elementToScroll && hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: 'smooth',
                            block: 'start'
                        });
                    }, 50);
                }

                if (timeWaitExceeded || !hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                }
            }, 50);
        }
    });

    globalThis.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');
            setTimeout(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);

                if (elementToScroll) {
                    elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        }
    });

    globalThis.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const componentIdLoadWaitTime = 5000;
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');

            const originalHash = location.hash;

            const startTimeRepeat = Date.now();
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);
                const timeWaitExceeded = Date.now() - startTimeRepeat > componentIdLoadWaitTime;

                const hashStillRelevant = location.hash === originalHash;

                if (elementToScroll && hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: 'smooth',
                            block: 'start'
                        });
                    }, 50);
                }

                if (timeWaitExceeded || !hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                }
            }, 50);
        }
    });

    globalThis.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');
            setTimeout(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);

                if (elementToScroll) {
                    elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        }
    });

    globalThis.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const componentIdLoadWaitTime = 5000;
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');

            const originalHash = location.hash;

            const startTimeRepeat = Date.now();
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);
                const timeWaitExceeded = Date.now() - startTimeRepeat > componentIdLoadWaitTime;

                const hashStillRelevant = location.hash === originalHash;

                if (elementToScroll && hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: 'smooth',
                            block: 'start'
                        });
                    }, 50);
                }

                if (timeWaitExceeded || !hashStillRelevant) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                }
            }, 50);
        }
    });

    globalThis.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
        if (location.hash) {
            const hashId = location.hash.replace('#', '');
            setTimeout(() => {
                const elementToScroll = globalThis.document?.getElementById(hashId);

                if (elementToScroll) {
                    elementToScroll.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        }
    });
